description: A content-addressed checkpoint of a run world: snapshot digest, per-run sequence number, world step index and recorded-at timestamp. Restore validates the ref chain — a foreign run checkpoint can never restore this run world.

digest.description: sha256 over the canonical serialization of the digest-free view.

snapshotDigest.description: Content address of the snapshotted world state.

stepIndex.description: World position captured by the snapshot.

title: Arena environment-runtime RunCheckpoint v1
